target: a telemetry hook must never lose the event it was called to record. Two JSON objects in one message made jq stream two values, breaking --argjson and dropping the ENTIRE agent_stop event — duration, usage, tier, model and summary along with the count.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; : > t.jsonl; printf "%s" "{\"hook_event_name\":\"SubagentStop\",\"session_id\":\"s1\",\"agent_id\":\"ag1\",\"agent_type\":\"loop-reviewer\",\"transcript_path\":\"$PWD/t.jsonl\",\"last_assistant_message\":\"{\\\"note\\\":\\\"d\\\",\\\"findings\\\":[1,2,3]}{\\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\",\\\"findings\\\":[9]}\",\"cwd\":\"$PWD\"}" | "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh"; n=$(cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); ev=$(cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | jq -r ".event"); printf '{"events":%s,"event":"%s"}' "$n" "$ev"
